text: NEOM is a closed joint-stock company fully owned by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund; Human Rights Watch describes NEOM as a PIF-funded giga-project.
short: NEOM is fully owned by Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund, PIF.

source.name: Saudi Press Agency: NEOM Established as a Closed Joint-Stock Company Owned by Saudi Sovereign Wealth Fund (archived copy)
source.quote: The newly-established entity is fully owned by the Public Investment Fund, the sovereign wealth fund of Saudi Arabia

additionalSources.name: Human Rights Watch, 'Die First, and I'll Pay You Later': Saudi Arabia's 'Giga-Projects' Built on Widespread Labor Abuses
additionalSources.quote: PIF-funded businesses and projects are among those exploiting and abusing migrant workers, including in NEOM, a PIF-funded giga-project
